raw_tokens.value: You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks, Initiative checks and cannot be tracked on the Astral Plane|FavoredTerrainAstralPlane

You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks when using these skills on the Astral Plane. Likewise, you get a +%1 bonus on initiative checks when on this plane. If you desire, you leave no trail on this plane and cannot be tracked.|FavoredTerrainAstralPlane
